snippet.title: CLASH : Heroes Of Feralia Terra | Trailer | 4K
snippet.description:
🛎️ Wishlist Now! If you wish to support us and find more information about the game / trailers / dev logs . Please visit our Steam page. 

🔷 STEAM STORE : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512550/CLASH/
🔷 EPIC GAMES : https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/clash-5f995e
🔷 More about the game : https://linktr.ee/Artnrollgames

An intense hybrid of hack-and-slash melee and ranged weaponry, enhanced with feral abilities tied to your hero's animal lineage. Unleash your feral instincts in visceral combat, scavenge, craft, explore corrupted landscapes, and destroy the cosmic horrors threatening all life.

#actionrpg #UE5 #indiegame #ClashHOFT

Original Music
Fran Soto / Epic Soul Factory
Sound Design / Mixing
Alex Papadopoulos / Artnroll Games
